text:
Stopping before the next variance increment is essential to this
bound \cite[thm.~4.5.2]{DurrettPTEAuthor2019}: for the first-exceedance
time the corresponding bound holds only when the stop is idle, and its
stopped second moments can be unbounded at every level
(\cref{thm:p15-w02c-p15-021-exceedance-bound,thm:p15-w02c-p15-021-unbounded-overshoot}).
